title: AWS previews Policy in Bedrock AgentCore to intercept every tool call with Cedar rules
summary: On 2 December 2025 AWS announced a preview of Policy in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, which integrates with AgentCore Gateway to intercept every tool call in real time; teams create policies in natural language that automatically convert to Cedar, the AWS open-source policy language, so enforcement sits outside the agent's code. The same release previewed AgentCore Evaluations, which offers 13 built-in evaluators and custom model-based scoring to test and continuously monitor agent performance based on real-world behavior; Evaluations is in preview in four AWS Regions and Policy in all Regions where AgentCore is available.
verification_note: URL fetched on 2026-10-17; AWS What's New post titled 'Amazon Bedrock AgentCore now includes Policy (preview), Evaluations (preview) and more', posted Dec 2, 2025. Confirmed from the page: Policy integrates with AgentCore Gateway to intercept every tool call in real time, natural-language policies convert to Cedar, Evaluations has 13 built-in evaluators plus custom model-based scoring, both in preview (Evaluations in four Regions).
